item.title: Cam Skattebo: Could be headed for lighter workload
item.description:
Skattebo had a "pretty even split in reps" this week with fellow running back Najee Harris and could be in store for fewer snaps and touches than usual in Sunday's game against the Saints, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

item.title: Pat Freiermuth: Chance to play in Week 6
item.description:
The Steelers are "optimistic" that Freiermuth (calf) -- who is listed as questionable -- will play Sunday at Tampa Bay, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

item.title: Tyler Shough: Playing through broken bones in hand
item.description:
Shough has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

item.title: Kenyon Sadiq: Slated to suit up in Week 6
item.description:
Sadiq (concussion) is listed as questionable but is in line to play in Sunday's game at New England, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

item.title: Alvin Kamara: Slated to play Sunday
item.description:
Kamara (back), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest at the Giants, is expected to play, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
